rites.text: A grappling technique where a fighter seizes an opponent's head and drives them down onto the ground. It is used by a masked wrestler and is reworked into a stronger version in later bouts.

rites.name: Valaureles
rites.text: A paired striking technique performed by a lucky fighter who follows the first blow with a second that seeks out its target. The follow-up strike also spins the opponent off balance.

rites.name: Sintiaria
rites.text: A coordinated strike sequence performed by a healer-fighter who links swift blows into a single flowing attack. It is recorded as a signature technique in a modern tournament of paired combatants.

rites.name: Solaurium
rites.text: A paired striking technique in which a warrior rapidly hooks with both hands in succession. It is practiced by one fighter known for their mastery of it in recent combat tournaments.

rites.name: Sentium
rites.text: A tumbling technique that lets several fighters rise from a low stance into an inverted balance. They carry it through every bout they enter.

rites.name: Amentanum
rites.text: A fighter's descending strike, delivered by plunging onto a fallen rival or from behind. Some users spring back afterward, while others stay low and force a rival to crouch.

rites.name: Amolia
rites.text: A close-range striking technique where a fighter drives the point of the elbow forward. It is favored by a brawler in the modern arena circuit.

rites.name: Veostauntia
rites.text: A combat maneuver used by one fighter in recent contests of arms. In the newest version it works as a heat-charging strike that builds a surge of power.

rites.name: Amontes
rites.text: A dive-and-strike maneuver favored by one fighter, performed with a swooping motion. It is a move that has been used since the newer iteration of the arena contests.

rites.name: Cerniallus
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which the body twirls twice in a sharp, feline-like motion. It is performed by one practitioner known for her agility.

rites.name: Ceolestia
rites.text: A swift strike that a fighter can unleash in the middle of a bout. It also primes a heated state that lets the next blow land harder.

rites.name: Nerallor
rites.text: A fighting posture first taught to one practitioner and later shared with others. It can be adopted by several different fighters across later contests.

rites.name: Vaustia
rites.text: A coined striking technique taught to a wandering duelist that replaces older slides and sweeps. Timed correctly, its low crouching form grows stronger, and a fighter in a fervent state can spend that surge to fire a precise version that gives back some of the energy it cost.

rites.name: Teleolintum
rites.text: A evasive maneuver where a fighter drops low and slips inside an opponent's strike. It has been practiced by a single skilled combatant since first appearing in a famous tournament of fists.

rites.name: Voranum
rites.text: A grappling technique that a fighter uses to hurl an opponent with crushing force. Over time it adapts into a different style of attack, shifting from a signature finisher to a forceful strike that breaks through an opponent's guard.

rites.name: Mialanum
rites.text: A combat technique used by a fighter making a first appearance in a modern brawling arena. It is one of the moves that the fighter performs during an early bout.

rites.name: Valanes
rites.text: A swift, low kicking technique that a wild-hearted fighter has used since first entering the arena, later passed on to a second combatant who returns to the ring.

rites.name: Corinteonum
rites.text: A dazzling technique practiced by one fighter in a modern arena contest. It is a move used by a single combatant since her first appearance in the tournament.

rites.name: Orastia
rites.text: A fighter's looping combination of heavy blows that ends with a hooking swing. A rival's later technique is shaped after it, and in a tag bout its finishing strike can be queued early by a partner.

rites.name: Corantiles
rites.text: A fighting technique used by one combatant who has performed it since first entering the arena. It is a repeatable strike drawn from the warrior's personal style.

rites.name: Seranollum
rites.text: A spinning fighting technique used by a nimble warrior, extending an earlier whirling strike into a second rotation. It is a refined form of the basic spin attack.

rites.name: Veonirnia
rites.text: A fighter's technique that begins with a forward kick and is followed by a turning drop. It has been performed by a masked brawler and by a combat machine in a later tournament.

rites.name: Rausor Valaurus
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent and hurls them with a strike to the head. It has been used by a warrior since a tag combat tournament.

rites.name: Ninor
rites.text: A rising tusk-thrust technique used by a veteran brawler, often chained into longer combinations. It can also launch an opponent upward into a wall bounce.

rites.name: Meolor
rites.text: A fighting technique that a skilled practitioner performs in a sweeping, angled motion. Its input sequence was altered when a new strike was introduced, and in later versions it is no longer available to fighters.

rites.name: Orolia
rites.text: A striking technique that a single fighter performs with a swift kick chain. In a later revision its finishing blow was dropped, and the strike that follows leaves the fighter facing away from the opponent.

rites.name: Amasistium
rites.text: A spinning hooking maneuver that a brawler performs during a tag-team fighting bout. It is used by one fighter of a duo in a competitive arena match.

rites.name: Tastellia
rites.text: A evasive maneuver favored by one fighter since their first appearance. Later versions let a particular input end the stance and drop the fighter into a crouch instead.

rites.name: Naures
rites.text: A fighter's striking technique that unfolds as a swift leg sweep followed by a rising kick. Its final blow can be held back for a moment before it lands.

rites.name: Amelliarnum
rites.text: A striking technique is used by a fighter since their first appearance in a combat tournament. It is a signature blow favored by one warrior in the ring.

rites.name: Oreostanum
rites.text: A fighter's forward rushing strike that a dark-feathered warrior learns from a grim mentor and can also unleash while turned away from the foe. Later refinements let it shatter the arena walls when it lands.

rites.name: Lastor
rites.text: A practiced stepping maneuver that two fighters share in a single motion. Rapidly striking before the routine begins breaks the rhythm and turns it into an ordinary blow.

rites.name: Amaustium
rites.text: A fighting technique that one warrior has used since first entering combat in a major tournament. It is a signature maneuver applied in close-quarters battle.

rites.name: Rallauntus
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a fighter uses a consuming surge of energy to unleash a sudden, dark strike. Its use draws down a single reserve of stored power.

rites.name: Corilenanum
rites.text: A forward-lunging strike favored by three fighters who use it across every contest they enter. Its quick, piercing thrust lets a combatant close the gap before the opponent can react.

rites.name: Leniastanum
rites.text: A grappling maneuver in which a fighter hooks an opponent's arm across the chest, then hurls them down to the ground. Several members of one bloodline have learned it, and it is taught in later training halls.

rites.name: Molus
rites.text: A combat maneuver employed by one fighter across several bouts. Its second strike can be held back, and in some versions it leaves the opponent briefly stunned, while in another it ignites a surge of power.

rites.name: Orontum
rites.text: A grappling technique a fighter applies after a particular hold, sending the foe hurtling into a nearby barrier for extra harm. Under certain conditions it can also shatter the surrounding wall or ledge.

rites.name: Coreostirus
rites.text: A striking maneuver that a masked wrestler performs to daze an opponent's head. It is used by a fighter who first appeared in a combat tournament.

rites.name: Oreornentia
rites.text: A fighter steps forward and then spins around in a deceptive motion. It acts as a false opening that mimics a more dangerous self-destructive strike.

rites.name: Reolus Amorellor
rites.text: A devastating unstoppable strike performed by a hulking mechanical brawler. It can be used by several later models of the machine, though the earliest two versions cannot perform it.

rites.name: Corontilor
rites.text: A quick evasive technique a fighter performs to slip away from an incoming strike. Practitioners can lengthen it by repeating the same motion while rising back up.

rites.name: Sesia
rites.text: A practiced grappling maneuver employed by a certain fighter since her first appearance in a combat tournament. It is a throw technique used in close-quarters bouts.

rites.name: Raustium
rites.text: A deliberate strike technique wielded by a fighter named Veri, serving as her overwhelming finishing blow in combat. It is unleashed when her inner fury is fully kindled.

rites.name: Rernantum
rites.text: A low-sweeping technique used by a winged fighter in a team combat tournament. It strikes an opponent's feet and knocks them off balance.

rites.name: Sollum
rites.text: A powerful upward punch that a fighter throws with a heavy armored swing. It has been a signature technique of one brawler for many contests.

rites.name: Mentus
rites.text: A bear-like fighter's unblockable swipe, passed down to later bears and cancelable into a rolling follow-up. In one tagged iteration, it also grants a hunting stance and can be deflected low.

rites.name: Tialentus
rites.text: A rapid chain of strikes performed by a single brawler, which becomes stronger when a boastful display is completed beforehand.

rites.name: Nistus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter sweeps a hatchet-like blade around twice in a rapid spinning strike. A bold warrior of a later era is known for mastering it.

rites.name: Telarnanum
rites.text: A combined technique in which a fighter pairs two simultaneous guard breaks into a single linked motion. It is practiced by a single named duelist of the modern era.

rites.name: Lostelum
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by a warrior who executes it in a brawl-style combat contest. It is one of the attacks this fighter relies on during matches.

rites.name: Ameror Nisia
rites.text: A joint technique performed by two fighters who share a bond. It is used only by these two and appears in a single crossover gathering.

rites.name: Corillum
rites.text: A striking technique that a single fighter employs in close combat, first demonstrated during an early tournament of clashing champions, and used as a signature strike.

rites.name: Ameontus
rites.text: A fighter's combined technique begins with a heavy stamp and follows with a sweeping strike from the striking arm. In newer forms the second blow flows directly into a bold rising stance.

rites.name: Amiantes
rites.text: A fighting technique used by one brawler, first appearing in an early tournament and carried into later ones. It is one of the signature combat maneuvers of its wielder.

rites.name: Ceontaustus
rites.text: A rising strike performed by a fighter who drops low and then springs upward. It has been a signature technique for one warrior across several bouts.

rites.name: Ninaria
rites.text: A fighter performs a rearward hop that strikes twice, once on the leap backward and again as the performer springs back upright. Holding a downward input instead drops the performer flat to the ground.

rites.name: Amiaseostum
rites.text: A spinning strike favored by two fighting forms of a shared bloodline, handed down between them over time. Its finishing combo can be cut short by holding a button, and it can pass cleanly to an ally during a team swap.

rites.name: Telestus
rites.text: A fighter's striking technique is drawn from a low, prowling stance. It is unleashed from a secondary crouched posture and is practiced by a single named combatant.

rites.name: Vialum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that pairs a raised knee strike with a rapid flurry of fist blows. Holding forward after it lets the user shift into a towering, brutish stance.

rites.name: Ameosauntum
rites.text: A grappling throw that a brawler hurls an opponent with, twisting their body around the thrower's arm. Several fighters across different eras have learned to perform it.

rites.name: Mianesum
rites.text: A recovery technique that a masked warrior uses in combat, first employed in a later round of a fighting contest. It is performed as a reversal from a downed position, turning a losing exchange into a swift retreat.

rites.name: Mirnum
rites.text: A practiced sequence of blows performed by a skilled fighter, first recorded in a later era of combat tournaments. It is known for chaining together rapid strikes.

rites.name: Saurnintus
rites.text: A fighting technique passed down by a single combatant in a sparring arena, a modified version of an older strike. When the foot connects with an opponent who is leaping, it sends them spinning through the air.

rites.name: Telilanum Virnor
rites.text: A bladed kick technique favored by a single fighter in later arena contests. Its strike can be queued ahead of a partner's turn in team bouts.

rites.name: Sinium
rites.text: A bold striking technique carried by a fighter who entered the arena recently. Practitioners use it to open attacks with a quick, aggressive rush.

rites.name: Neorernium
rites.text: A forward-thrusting foot technique aimed at the joint of the leg. A fighter from a distant hall has relied on it since first entering the tournament circuit.

rites.name: Vistes
rites.text: A combat maneuver a warrior may perform while a surge of fighting fervor is burning within him. Following a specific sequence of strikes, he substitutes a different final input to launch a sudden tackling ambush.

rites.name: Varnintum
rites.text: A practiced fighting maneuver used by a single combatant in a modern tournament arena. It is a named technique that the user performs during bouts.

rites.name: Ternia
rites.text: A practiced evasive technique used by a nimble fighter from her first appearance onward. It tracks toward an opponent and sets off a spinning counter, leaving the user facing away afterward.

rites.name: Leostus
rites.text: A combat technique performed by a duelist that, when its second strike connects, lets the user enter a radiant burst state. Only a successful follow-up hit triggers the transformation.

rites.name: Orausium
rites.text: A fighter's sequenced strike that a single wielder performs in combat. It is built on an older striking pattern learned from a distant master.

rites.name: Seriares
rites.text: A sudden combat maneuver that a fighter uses to strike opponents. It has been taught to a single warrior in a later rebellion of combatants.

rites.name: Ceontia
rites.text: A paired striking technique performed by a brawler who has carried it since first entering the arena. In the newest tournament it is a special move that charges a heat surge.

rites.name: Meraunes
rites.text: A non-damaging technique used by a single fighter that drives her forward automatically toward an opponent. Its timing and effect shift with distance and with the opponent's facing.

rites.name: Reosornanum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that links a swift dark-cloaked strike into a lunar-style gliding dodge. It is performed by a dancer-like combatant in a modern arena contest.

rites.name: Telenorus
rites.text: A striking technique in which a fighter drives open-palmed force forward in rapid rhythmic bursts. It is practiced by one combatant who has used it in a recent tournament-era struggle.

rites.name: Reoria
rites.text: A deceptive grappling maneuver used by a single fighter who has built inner energy. While charged, the seizing hold cannot be escaped and gives off bright blue sparks.

rites.name: Raurnum
rites.text: A bold combat posture held by a fighter and her fierce inner-demon form. It lets the user press forward through blows without flinching.

rites.name: Castoles
rites.text: A evasive acrobatic maneuver in which a fighter flips backward and vanishes into a haze of light. It is performed by a particular duelist in a more recent generation of combat.

rites.name: Saulum
rites.text: A fiery technique that a fighter unleashes in a rising blaze of flame. Its dark twin version is held by another warrior, who also commands a sacred cousin of the same blazing style.

rites.name: Mallus
rites.text: A short-range energy bolt used by a single fighter to strike an opponent who is about to attack. It has been part of that fighter's repertoire since their first appearance in combat.

rites.name: Menilus
rites.text: A leaping technique wielded by three fighters across every contest they enter. Practitioners spring into a shimmering evasive burst that confuses opponents.

rites.name: Orarnellia
rites.text: A fighting posture adopted by a warrior during their first appearance in a tournament of martial combat. It is one of the distinct methods that a combatant uses to shape their strikes.

rites.name: Maurnus
rites.text: A close-quarters grappling technique used by a noble fighter, who seizes an opponent and hurls them down. A bonded attendant can join in, letting two allies perform a combined throw together.

rites.name: Amianernus
rites.text: A striking technique used by a particular fighter in a combat contest. It is a sweeping kick, performed as part of a duel's repertoire.

rites.name: Corialum
rites.text: A reckless dive move used by a masked swordsman that stuns himself on contact and can lash out in a flurry. Missing it sends him crashing into walls, hurting himself.

rites.name: Vesium
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a fighter swivels away from an opponent, presenting their back. Its user has performed it since first entering the arena.

rites.name: Corireonia
rites.text: A combat maneuver a fighter performs by striking high with the lead hand and then sweeping low with the leg. A later variant adds a second low strike, and the newest version swaps out an older technique.

rites.name: Cosillus
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by a single fighter in a modern brawling arena. It is one practiced strike sequence the fighter performs during bouts.

rites.name: Viantum Orernes
rites.text: A counterstrike technique that a fighter in the modern arena can use to turn an incoming attack back against the attacker. It has been taught to a single brawler in recent contests.

rites.name: Reontanum
rites.text: A devastating technique wielded by a fearsome warrior in a modern combat arena. In a defunct handheld contest it appears as a card that strengthens the warrior during timed challenges, hitting foes harder and forcing them into a hurried struggle.

rites.name: Corialium
rites.text: A fighter's chained strike that begins with a low sweep and ends with a rising kick. It was a standard technique for many years until a newer rushing attack took its place.

rites.name: Siastor
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a masked wrestler champion, known from earlier tournament bouts and later revived by his successor. It is a sudden kicking attack aimed at an opponent's upper body.

rites.name: Nestosum
rites.text: A raised-arm striking maneuver favored by a grim combatant of the eastern steppe lands. It was first displayed during a tournament of brutal duels.

rites.name: Veoresum
rites.text: A stealthy overhead strike performed by a fighter who has used it since a second tag tournament. It is a signature technique that rises above the ground to catch opponents off guard.

rites.name: Telornantus
rites.text: A fighter's technique where the trailing leg lifts high and sweeps through the opponent's guard in a single arcing strike. It is practiced by a single duelist and appears in two different combat contests.

rites.name: Corintum
rites.text: A grappling technique favored by one fighter, first used in a later era of combat. It stands in for an older, similar throw.

rites.name: Tiarnor
rites.text: A low sweeping kick chained in a sequence by a fighter, used from an early appearance onward until the technique was dropped from later versions of the art.

rites.name: Cirauntus
rites.text: A fighter's technique that begins with a sidelong kick and can flow into a rotating stance or a retreating hop. A refined variant of the strike has been reworked to hit with new force.

rites.name: Corosum
rites.text: A brutal close-range striking technique in which a fighter drives the sharp joint of the arm into an opponent. It has become a signature method used by a particular brawler in recent contests.

rites.name: Orelleoria
rites.text: A swift strike technique that a pair of fighters use in combat. It has been practiced since a later training era.

rites.name: Vaunium
rites.text: A fighter's stance in which the body coils to one side before launching a rocket-like strike. A practitioner reuses it across generations and returns to it in later contests.

rites.name: Vaulus
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a fighter in a modern brawling tournament. Its second strike carries a spinning, whirlwind-like force.

rites.name: Liarnor
rites.text: A practiced counter-maneuver that a single fighter uses to answer a deflected blow. In a later revision it triggers on its own whenever a parry succeeds.

rites.name: Meolor Nollernia
rites.text: A bewitching technique used by one fighter in a combat arena contest. It holds an opponent's attention in a dazzling, hypnotic display.

rites.name: Coranium Saustia
rites.text: A deceptive shimmering technique once practiced by three fighters, later erased from the training halls. It was dropped from the combat repertoire after a later era of contests.

rites.name: Orillantes
rites.text: A combat technique a fighter can perform in a two-part sequence. The follow-up strike lands only when the target is struck from the front.

rites.name: Sereonum
rites.text: A fighter's signature strike that unleashes a searing energy beam from the hands. Its wielder can pass it down to a darker form, and a final burst can whip a spiraling gale into airborne foes.

rites.name: Valliarus
rites.text: A fighter's guarded stance that must be entered from a crouched foothold first. It adds a second advancing step, drawing the fighter closer to a waiting foe.

rites.name: Seostium
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by a single warrior in a duel-tournament arena. It was dropped from the training rolls for a time, then restored with a fresh gesture.

rites.name: Telaurnes
rites.text: A chained strike that begins with a blow to the lower ribs and ends in a leaping punch. It is performed by a fighter named Maren Dalo.

rites.name: Corilanum
rites.text: A fighting technique wielded by a single brawler in a combat arena. It is a strike that a fighter unleashes during a brawl.

rites.name: Seoraunor
rites.text: A fluid striking technique passed down by a single martial artist, delivered with a sweeping low motion. It has been practiced since a recent tournament era.

rites.name: Cialornor
rites.text: A hollowing strike is practiced by a single fighter who has used it since a later tournament-era cycle. It is a technique tied to one named combatant and her signature style.

rites.name: Valianostor
rites.text: A fighter known for a technique in which the attacker springs into the air and brings one heel down upon the foe. It has been practiced by a single combatant since a later generation of tournament bouts.

rites.name: Collastes
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a warrior that begins with a strike which, when it lands as a counter, leaves the opponent doubled over and briefly stunned. In a team variant, its follow-up blow can be queued by a partner.

rites.name: Telinor
rites.text: A low, sweeping spinning kick delivered with the right leg, used by a fighter in her debut. It is a technique in a combat style.

rites.name: Amollistia
rites.text: A tactical strike technique used by a fighter in an arena since a recent tournament. It is delivered with a sharp midsection kick.

rites.name: Viasalium
rites.text: A fighter's practiced sequence of a quick forward strike followed by a sweeping spinning kick. It is a signature technique passed down among certain martial performers.

rites.name: Veollares
rites.text: A combat maneuver performed by a pair of returning fighters, extending an earlier technique. Its final strike triggers a binding effect on the opponent.

rites.name: Amialanum
rites.text: A fighter's throwing technique in which a combatant seizes an opponent and hurls them to the ground. It is favored by a ruthless brawler who prizes raw force above all else.

rites.name: Virneosium
rites.text: A floating maneuver that lets a fighter remain suspended briefly above the ground. It is used by one particular combatant since her first appearance in the arena.

rites.name: Serasia
rites.text: A spinning aerial strike that a masked wrestler performs with a raised leg. It has been used in a recent combat tournament by one fighter in particular.

rites.name: Tallor
rites.text: A fighter's practiced sequence of strikes, first learned in a later age of brawling. It is performed by a single combatant who has trained in it.

rites.name: Caurnum
rites.text: A fighter's crouching leap that hits harder when repeated in a row. A pinning drop on a standing foe strikes the chest for extra harm.

rites.name: Ciaseornium
rites.text: A fighter's technique that begins with a quick sequence of strikes and ends with a sudden sweeping kick. It was once part of a particular performer's repertoire before being dropped from the training manuals.

rites.name: Laulium
rites.text: A fighter's kicking technique that, once performed, shifts the practitioner into a guarded side-facing posture. In later bouts it can knock an opponent into a stumbling bound.

rites.name: Amiasum
rites.text: A swift looping strike sequence that a wandering fighter once used across many arenas, later swapped for a harsher technique. In a shared-brawl arena it could be performed more quickly, and in one story mode its final blows return only when the fighter's inner power is gone.

rites.name: Amauntolus
rites.text: A grappling-style technique performed from a low stance, used by two fighters in a later tournament-combat tradition. It is a maneuver passed between combatants who train within the same arena circuit.

rites.name: Seraurnanum
rites.text: A evasive leap backward that a returned warrior uses to slip away from attacks. It was adopted again after his comeback in a later tournament.

rites.name: Valaustelus
rites.text: A combat technique first taught to a brawler in a later age of arena duels. It has a fading variant performed while the fighter closes their eyes, and it grew out of an older sequence of rapid blows.

rites.name: Tilium
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a brawler in a modern combat tournament. It is a kicking maneuver that combines a sweeping strike with a rising follow-up.

rites.name: Naseornor
rites.text: A striking technique where a fighter lands a blow to the lower side of the body and then slides in close. It was first adopted by a practitioner in a more recent era of combat.

rites.name: Serenes Oreornillum
rites.text: A sliding technique a fighter has carried through several bouts of a combat contest. In its latest form it can set off a spinning whirlwind, and its motion has been refined slightly.

rites.name: Reontus Coroseres
rites.text: A fighter's combat posture that empowers certain strikes in place of an older energy technique, marked by bright flares along the forearms. While an overheated surge is active, the posture is held permanently and that surge is spent instead.

rites.name: Lonium
rites.text: A solitary fighting posture adopted by a single combatant who first appeared in a later clash of arms. It is one of several stances the warrior may take in battle.

rites.name: Coneolum
rites.text: A practiced striking technique that one fighter has relied on since first appearing in a major brawling contest. It is delivered by hand in close combat.

rites.name: Sinus
rites.text: A flowing strike sequence used by a skilled fighter, in which the attacker sweeps an opponent's limbs in a chain of rapid blows. The technique has been practiced by this fighter for several years.

rites.name: Nolus
rites.text: A ruler's fighting technique in which a crouching leap curls into a hooking strike. It has been practiced by a masked warrior since a later tournament era.

rites.name: Orauntia
rites.text: A fighting technique passed down through a family of combatants, performed by an elder and later inherited by a daughter who uses it in the same way. It is a signature maneuver in tournament bouts.

rites.name: Amauses
rites.text: A fighting technique passed between several combatants across competitions. One later practitioner learned it during her early career, and in a team tournament it can be prepared ahead by a partner.

rites.name: Seolasia
rites.text: A paired bodily technique used by two fighters, practiced across several generations of a contest before it is dropped from the repertoire.

rites.name: Roles
rites.text: A evasive sidestep technique in which a fighter slips behind an opponent's strike to counter. It is practiced by a single skilled combatant of a modern martial art.

rites.name: Ceontisanum
rites.text: A fighter's linked sequence that begins with a heavy overhand blow and finishes with a brutal follow-up. The finisher always lands with a bright blue flare.

rites.name: Meones
rites.text: A coiled technique wielded by a towering brawler, first shown in a later fighting contest. It lets its user unleash a sudden burst of force.

rites.name: Caleosanum
rites.text: A fighter's combat technique that begins with a pair of rising kicks and ends with a backhand strike. It is practiced by one particular warrior who first displayed it in a major tournament.

rites.name: Tisteror
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by one warrior, who has used it in combat since an arena contest many years ago. It is a strike performed in a set sequence to overwhelm opponents.

rites.name: Laliarnia
rites.text: A fighter's standard two-part strike that flows naturally into a spinning turn. The first blow can lift a foe unexpectedly when it lands at the right moment.

rites.name: Sonialles
rites.text: A close-quarters striking technique drawn from a warrior's sharp inner arm, later dropped from the repertoire and its command assigned to a vigilance discipline instead.

rites.name: Corasor
rites.text: A practiced spinning strike used by a skilled fighter, passed among several combatants over later rounds of a contest. In a newer version the wielder turns the opposite way before the final kick.

rites.name: Veoranum
rites.text: A bearer enters a glowing, empowered state marked by a shimmering golden aura and a visible timer. Strikes performed while surging gain added force and new effects, though activating it costs a portion of the stored energy reserve.

rites.name: Meorosium
rites.text: A fighter's technique that links two separate strikes in sequence. Each strike is performed on its own, and the pair forms a single combination.

rites.name: Tauseostor
rites.text: A fighter's reserve of surge energy appears as a blue gauge beneath the life meter. Once invoked, the warrior glows with a pale azure halo while the gauge shifts to violet, and it restores itself at the start of each new bout.

rites.name: Tantianum
rites.text: A fighter's aerial strike, a rising leap followed by a quick snapping kick. It is performed by a practitioner of a particular long-standing style and has been part of their arsenal for many years.

rites.name: Niarnes
rites.text: A fighter's signature two-handed strike sequence, first learned by a rival warrior and later shared by his alter ego. Its finishing blow can be held back, and in an older mobile version it opens combos that chip away at the foe.

rites.name: Maustalum
rites.text: A swift striking technique drawn from a gliding dance stance, performed by a dancer in a particular fighting form. It is used as one of that stance's signature movements.

rites.name: Orisiantium
rites.text: A coiled striking technique performed by a fighter in a team-based arena contest, where the second blow can be queued during a partner's turn.

rites.name: Venor
rites.text: A grappling maneuver a warrior performs to hurl a foe, favored since its first appearance in a rival clan's tournament. In one later version a different technique takes its place, and a kin fighter can also perform it.

rites.name: Valaustia
rites.text: A combat maneuver performed by a brawler in an arena fighting tradition. It was once a signature technique of one fighter before being replaced by a newer strike.

rites.name: Tarnus
rites.text: A quick forward strike that a fighter delivers with the front hand, followed by a sweeping kick. A practitioner of a particular style uses it in battle.

rites.name: Mollia
rites.text: A coiled strike technique used by a skilled duelist in a modern fighting contest. It drives a sharp, piercing blow straight through an opponent's guard.

rites.name: Vallia
rites.text: A fighter's spinning heel strike that a single warrior uses across many contests. Its command sequence was rearranged later so the warrior could chain it into a fiery follow-up while standing in a particular posture.

rites.name: Casaurnor
rites.text: A two-strike rhythmic technique used by a pair of related fighters. The second blow lands slower and heavier than the first, and striking at the exact last moment softens the opening hit.

rites.name: Telalenum
rites.text: A striking technique wielded by one particular fighter since she first appeared in a combat tournament. It is a signature maneuver tied to her personal style.

rites.name: Oriarnanum
rites.text: A fighter's chained strike sequence used by one warrior since first appearing in the arena. It rises from the ground in a sequence of flowing blows.

rites.name: Teloristor
rites.text: A rising strike driven by the knee that a fighter can launch from a tag partner's cue. It is used by a brawler and by a hulking foe in a later bout.

rites.name: Nillauranum
rites.text: A fighter's sudden heel strike, thrown forward with a rising leg. A second, mirrored version of the same kick is performed by another practitioner.

rites.name: Siarnes Cialum
rites.text: A leaping combat technique performed by a rogue warrior since an early training cycle. In its later form it no longer topples the foe but flows into a fierce lion-hearted stance.

rites.name: Canteorum
rites.text: A stronger form of a fighting technique performed by a skilled combatant in a tournament-style arena. After its second strike, a quick downward input lets the fighter drop into a crouch to recover.

rites.name: Vianirnus
rites.text: A practiced striking technique used by a fighter in a combat contest. It is one of the moves that a single combatant relies on during a bout of arena fighting.

rites.name: Vosanum
rites.text: A fighting posture adopted by a particular warrior since her debut in a tournament of combat. It is a stance that practitioners use in battle.

rites.name: Talles
rites.text: A grappling maneuver performed by a single fighter who first learned it in a major tournament. Two other combatants have their own variations of the same throw.

rites.name: Laureonia
rites.text: A fighter's signature kick technique that can be launched from one stance or another, with the second version being riskier. Its variants can sometimes set off a spinning follow-up.

rites.name: Amonia Sereolia
rites.text: A swift striking technique taught to one warrior who wields it in a martial style. It was first shown in a later tournament-era duel and is performed with a sharp, sudden kick.

rites.name: Siarnum
rites.text: A fighting technique wielded by a skilled brawler in a tournament-style arena contest. It is a close-range strike used during combat.

rites.name: Siasium
rites.text: A fighting technique passed between two rival practitioners since their first clash. When one returns after an absence, the strike is replaced by a sweeping rising kick.

rites.name: Taullenia
rites.text: A grappling maneuver passed down to a wielder of a masked persona, which the masked identity may also perform. It first appeared in a team contest and was later shared with a second form.

rites.name: Ventus Nentolium
rites.text: A grappling maneuver in which a fighter lifts an opponent and hurls them down from above while both are airborne. It is performed by one warrior who has practiced it for a long time.

rites.name: Castes
rites.text: A combat technique where a fighter throws a looping left swing that ends in a low kick to the opponent's leg. It appears in two later duel-tournament arenas and belongs to a single brawler's repertoire.

rites.name: Tanteonus
rites.text: A fighter's descending kick that, when it lands cleanly on a foe leaping through the air from the front, transitions into a grappling seize. It can also be unleashed from a balanced one-legged stance.

rites.name: Mornintus
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a brawler who sidesteps during the third or fourth strike of a combo. Its later strikes can be held back to alter the timing.

rites.name: Sereonerium
rites.text: A fearsome technique that a shadowy trickster draws upon, first revealed in a fighter's early appearance and later taken up by a master who inherits it in a later clash.

rites.name: Saulastium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior shifts into a fiery combat posture after a spinning blade strike. The move is performed by one martial artist in a tournament-style arena battle.

rites.name: Liles
rites.text: A fighter's striking maneuver that replaces an older combination of kicks. Its second blow sets off a whirlwind and moves the user into a different guard position.

rites.name: Nellus
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a brawler who seizes an opponent and presses them down. It is performed while the fighter holds a dominant position over a fallen rival.

rites.name: Valesaulor
rites.text: A ruthless strike technique favored by an old war-lord of the clans, later extended with a deadly follow-up sequence. Its hand signal was reassigned in a later age, and the original gesture passed to a sharper ritual of claw-cutting.

rites.name: Orasianus
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a masked brawler who seizes a foe with a forearm sweep. It is applied as the finishing follow-up after a stunning strike lands cleanly.

rites.name: Serorauntus
rites.text: A close-quarters strike performed by pressing a rising knee into an opponent, followed by a sweeping spin. Two fighters in the same circle have used it for years.

rites.name: Cauntilia
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a warrior in a modern combat arena, where it stands in place of an older signature maneuver. It is a strike that takes the place of a prior move.

rites.name: Venum
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a fighter sweeps a low strike at the opponent's lower leg, then drives a knee upward in a sudden explosive follow-up. It is performed by a warrior from a fighting tradition known for its striking arts.

rites.name: Mialles Valosum
rites.text: A fighter's striking technique is a variant of a rapid fist-flurry, and its follow-up blow can be held back to trigger a spiraling twist.

rites.name: Vollinus
rites.text: A quick combat maneuver performed by a skilled fighter, first adopted by a younger practitioner and later reused by another in a rematch of arena contests.

rites.name: Telauranum
rites.text: A fighter's opening technique that begins with a quick striking burst and transitions into a flowing aerial strike. It has been used by a single warrior since first appearing in a tournament arena.

rites.name: Coraria
rites.text: A leaping low sweeping blow used by a fighter in a duel of hands. Earlier forms knock the foe down, while later forms leave them sprawled face down.

rites.name: Meornia
rites.text: A practiced strike that certain warriors return to after an absence. It unleashes a binding effect in one contest and serves as a fighter's opening surge of power in a later one.

rites.name: Reollus
rites.text: A coiling technique that three fighters wield in every bout they enter. It draws a sudden shifting illusion across the battlefield to strike from an unexpected angle.

rites.name: Valelor
rites.text: A combat maneuver used by one fighter in a modern arena brawler, serving as one of his special Heat Engager techniques. It is a signature move that ignites a short burst of fiery power when the fighter performs it.

rites.name: Amalloranum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that chains a quick punch into a rising blow, then finishes with a forward kick. It has been performed by one practitioner since its first appearance.

rites.name: Valeontus Seriarnium
rites.text: A ritual fighting technique wielded by a single warrior who has trained in it since first entering the arena. It is performed in the dark, drawing on the silence of a moonless hour.

rites.name: Orarnus
rites.text: A ruinous blow delivered by a skilled fighter in a combat arena, unleashed as a single devastating strike. It is a signature technique belonging to one warrior's fighting style.

rites.name: Cornum
rites.text: A fighter attempts a flipping leap taught by a mentor, but lands badly and falls flat. Over time the botched stunt becomes a hidden technique that the fighter can perform in later bouts.

rites.name: Tarnanum
rites.text: A fighter's high kick that, from a certain point onward, chases its target and sometimes spins them into a twisting fall. Several characters in the same circle of practitioners have learned it.

rites.name: Valonintia
rites.text: A chained sequence of rapid blows used by a sharp-tongued fighter and their hidden persona. It has been passed down through several generations of tournaments.

rites.name: Causanum
rites.text: A sudden technique wielded by a sword-wielding fighter from an earlier era of the arena. It is performed as a single decisive strike from the same warrior's repertoire.

rites.name: Causellium
rites.text: A high aerial kick-spin technique practiced by three renowned fighters. They perform it across all their contests.

rites.name: Cauntillia
rites.text: A practiced strike used by a brawler from the fighting circuit. Once it lands, it sets off a twisting spin that wrenches the target's body.

rites.name: Valausanum
rites.text: A dancer's strike that begins by pointing a hand left and then sweeps into a rolling, rhythmic hit. The fighter can also perform it while stepping into a twisting guard.

rites.name: Telolanum
rites.text: A brutal close-quarters technique in which a fighter strikes an opponent's leg joint with a sudden, crippling blow. It is favored by brawlers who rely on quick footwork and unarmed force.

rites.name: Siror
rites.text: A grappling technique that a brawler performs in the middle of a fight, spinning an opponent around. Once begun, the fighter can shift into a turned-away stance by holding a directional input.

rites.name: Lernanum
rites.text: A fighter's technique is wielded by a warrior during a contest of paired combatants. It is a striking maneuver that belongs to one champion's repertoire.

rites.name: Sereonanum Ranollor
rites.text: A powerful rising strike performed by a single fighter, reinforced and charged so it hits harder than the standard version. It has been practiced by one combatant across several later bouts.

rites.name: Leraulanum
rites.text: A fighter's signature two-punch sequence that opens an attack chain. Its final blow can be held back and can send an opponent bouncing off a barrier.

rites.name: Vianaurium
rites.text: A coiling strike favored by two fighters across several contests. In the newest contest, the blow sets off a twisting spin that wrenches the opponent.

rites.name: Liniales
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a brawler since his first appearance in a tournament. In later editions it causes a sudden spiraling collapse in the opponent.

rites.name: Liales
rites.text: A fighting posture adopted by a masked duelist and their hidden twin persona. Pressing certain backward or forward directions releases the posture, and two of those directions lower the body into a crouch.

rites.name: Caurnus
rites.text: A two-part fighting technique practiced by two brawlers for many years. Its second blow can slam an opponent into a barrier, bouncing them back off it.

rites.name: Lirium
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a single fighter, carried over across several contests. In its later form it serves as a special charged strike that cannot be interrupted by ordinary hits.

rites.name: Teror
rites.text: A stance held by a fierce automaton-like warrior while she is in her unleashed mode. It is a waiting posture, adopted only during that volatile phase.

rites.name: Lostor
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which the wielder turns their back after the second blow of a combination. It is performed by a single practitioner who adopts this stance.

rites.name: Teleonolus
rites.text: A maneuver that a skilled fighter can execute only while mirroring an opponent's stance. It has been practiced by several combatants across different contests.

rites.name: Miaronus
rites.text: A bounding forward stance adopted by a masked grappler in the heat of battle. Once triggered, the advance becomes a crushing charge that spends part of the fighter's fury.

rites.name: Telosernes
rites.text: A fighter's technique that replaces an older maneuver in a later iteration of the art. Once executed, it triggers a spiraling twisting effect on the opponent.

rites.name: Rales Serialles
rites.text: A fighter's stance in which a clawed brawler winds into repeated turns, each turn strengthening the next blow. After six turns the brawler staggers and drops, while low strikes are crushed beneath the spinning body.

rites.name: Lianestia
rites.text: A brutal strike technique used by a towering brawler since his first appearance in a fighting tournament. It crushes foes through sheer force.

rites.name: Nilleonia
rites.text: A sudden shaking technique that a returning fighter uses to break free of holds in a tournament bout. Its power comes from rapid, violent body movement.

rites.name: Tilasia
rites.text: A brutal grappling strike where a fighter drives a foot down onto a downed opponent's skull. Under certain conditions it can shatter the arena floor beneath them.

rites.name: Vausia
rites.text: A striking technique that a fighter in a rival arena has used since a later tournament. It is a sharp, swinging motion that carries force through the arc of the attack.

rites.name: Miallus
rites.text: A raised-leg technique performed by a fighter in a combat contest, delivering a lethal finishing blow. It is one of the striking moves a combatant can use in a ring.

rites.name: Viastenum
rites.text: A coordinated low sweeping technique that a fighter uses to throw an opponent off their feet. It is practiced by a single lineage of warriors from a distant hall.

rites.name: Rostellor
rites.text: A fighting technique that a rival duelist adopts in place of an older kick sequence. Later a different maneuver takes its place within the same practitioner's repertoire.

rites.name: Valeostor Taurnanum
rites.text: A charged, sky-cracking punch that a wielder must gather power to unleash. It launches foes into the air but moves slowly, and it is easy to mistake for a quicker strike.

rites.name: Orallor
rites.text: A grappling maneuver in which a fighter seizes an opponent and snaps them into a sudden twisting throw. It is passed down among a few performers who have mastered it in combat.

rites.name: Cistus
rites.text: A counter-technique a warrior performs to turn an opponent's strike back against them. While a surge of heightened power burns, the warrior can also deflect strikes aimed at the middle of the body.

rites.name: Oreones
rites.text: A swooping technique performed by a skilled fighter in a combat tournament. Once introduced, it became a reliable power move that breaks through an opponent's guard.

rites.name: Amianaulus
rites.text: A bolt-hurling strike performed by a wielder and her fiendish alter-self, rendering a foe helpless in a single motion. It belongs to a combat art passed between the two forms.

rites.name: Oreornanum Nontales
rites.text: A hybrid fighting discipline and life philosophy that strips away rigid forms, keeping only the essentials that react to unpredictable clashes. Its teacher likens it to a cup refilled and emptied until nothing unnecessary remains.

rites.name: Resollor
rites.text: A ferocious heated blow used by a brawler in combat, serving as the fighter's signature overpowering technique. It is unleashed once the warrior's inner fire has been fully kindled.

rites.name: Taunus
rites.text: A violent, sudden whipping blast of wind that a warrior unleashes as a fighting technique. It is practiced by one particular fighter in a modern combat arena.

rites.name: Seraulanum
rites.text: A violent technique performed by a wielder and their demonic alter form, channeling a storm's fury into a single devastating blow. It is a signature maneuver linked to that dual-natured fighter.

rites.name: Valaunintor
rites.text: A fiery technique wielded by a single warrior, a stronger offshoot of an older flame strike. A later revision gives it a second way to be called upon in combat.

rites.name: Seostanum Castones
rites.text: A violent rushing strike is carried out by a fierce wielder while she is in her ruinous transformed state. The technique first appeared when she emerged in a rebellion of kin.

rites.name: Vaullor Mellium
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by a martial artist that shifts between serpentine and feline stances. Pressing a forward input during the opening strikes changes the stance mid-sequence, and the final strike always resets to the serpentine form.

rites.name: Seraulanum Caulium
rites.text: A practiced strike that a fighter from the desert tribes has used for years. Once it lands, the user shifts smoothly into a crouched, spider-like guard.

rites.name: Valenium Sellornia
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by a brawler who spins an opponent around in a sweeping motion. Its second strike causes the foe to become bound in place.

rites.name: Naunollium
rites.text: A rising punch thrown by a bearded inventor that lifts a foe straight upward and drops them flat. When the fighter lands, a crackling charge runs over his body and pulls him backward unless he steps forward.

rites.name: Ameollenor
rites.text: A fighter's precise strike that leaves an opponent briefly frozen in place. Once a regular technique in a later sequence, it was dropped from the roster of moves in a newer version.

rites.name: Naureollor
rites.text: A deliberate, heavy strike that can be linked into a follow-up sequence when it lands squarely from the front. Certain practitioners learn a version that flows into a low sweeping kick.

rites.name: Orauntium
rites.text: A spinning strike delivered by turning the back foot toward the target, aimed at the middle of the body. It has been a signature technique of one fighter since a long-running team tournament began.

rites.name: Cenia
rites.text: A combat maneuver practiced by a brawler since an early era. When its punch lands as a counter, the foe staggers backward, and it can flow into an evasive sway.

rites.name: Amiaristus
rites.text: A paired strike favored by one brawler, whose second blow lands on an opponent's weakened guard. A clean counter sends the foe staggering backward toward the floor.

rites.name: Sinia Tasia
rites.text: A rapid, punishing technique used by a veteran war-master since the Bloodline Rebellion. It is a short, decisive blow favored by those who fight with raw force.

rites.name: Sistanum
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by a single warrior, first displayed in a rebellion-themed contest. It is used by one particular combatant from her first appearance onward.

rites.name: Meonisia
rites.text: A swift evasive maneuver performed by a single fighter, favored by one particular warrior since first appearing in a prior tournament. Practitioners in the arena have given it a bird-inspired nickname.

rites.name: Liria
rites.text: A close-quarters striking technique in which a fighter drives a fist upward from below to launch an opponent. It was taken up by a shadowy duelist and later passed to a skilled apprentice.

rites.name: Oraustenum
rites.text: A fighter turns their back toward a rival yet can still step forward, dash, or sidestep without facing around. A single press reverses the pose and faces them again.

rites.name: Amaurnus
rites.text: A high rising strike that a few fighters have passed down through the years. Two lineages of practitioners have carried it forward, each learning it at a different point in their history.

rites.name: Tiantium
rites.text: A sharp, sweeping technique passed from one practitioner to another across generations. Its wielders are taught to strike with a cutting motion that unleashes a burst of force.

rites.name: Reontanum Teliastium
rites.text: A fighter's sweeping low kick used in tag combat, favored by one practitioner since the second major tournament of the circuit. It knocks an opponent's feet away in a wide arc.

rites.name: Vauntes
rites.text: A leaping strike launched from the ground, where the fighter rises into the air and delivers a forceful energy blow to an opponent below.

rites.name: Vosallor
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by one combatant, first used in a recent duel tournament. It is a wing-driven rush that launches the attacker into a swooping strike.

rites.name: Seralia
rites.text: A hidden fighting variant that lifts struck foes far higher and sends them back less, letting fighters chain extended aerial strings. Its hidden unlock requires finishing the full roster, then holding two buttons as the bout begins.

rites.name: Ciasium Vasum
rites.text: A fighter slips a quick tap of the body aside to dodge incoming blows, grabs, or unblockable strikes. It can also swap positions with the rival, letting one side flip the angle of the duel.

rites.name: Cernanum
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by a grappling brawler who lands a heavy downward stomp after a leap. Several fighters from the same family have learned it over successive contests.

rites.name: Tallium
rites.text: A swift strike technique used by a duelist that can shift into a follow-up grapple. It lifts an opponent into the air when it lands on a crouching foe or as a sharp counter.

rites.name: Vaunintium
rites.text: A combat technique performed by a single fighter in a sparring arena. The second strike must connect before the fighter can flow into a final blazing burst, and in later contests it also builds up a charged surge.

rites.name: Ciares
rites.text: A bear-like fighter unleashes a powerful combat maneuver that doubles as her ultimate burst technique. Pressing down during it shifts her into a stalking stance, while pressing forward rolls her across the ground.

rites.name: Serinauntus
rites.text: A flashy spinning maneuver used by a dancer-warrior in a modern combat arena contest. It is performed with a sudden twist of the body.

rites.name: Seorum
rites.text: A striking technique favored by one fighter since first appearing in a tournament of combat. It is performed with a rising arm and a sudden lunge.

rites.name: Corarum
rites.text: A foot-driven blow used by a warrior in a fighting arena. It serves as his own variation of a common strike performed with the same button pattern.

rites.name: Neollares
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by a duelist of the courtly class, it unleashes a sudden forceful strike that is empowered when the fighter's inner fire peaks.

rites.name: Telolia
rites.text: A steel-toed kick technique that a single fighter has used in combat since the later sequels of a long-running brawling tournament. It is a signature strike wielded by one warrior.

rites.name: Sereolus
rites.text: A grappling throw in which a fighter seizes an opponent's arm and wrenches the shoulder joint. It belongs to a single combatant's repertoire in a tag-team brawling contest.

rites.name: Coreontus
rites.text: A fighter's quick aerial spinning kick, a near copy of an older flip that was reshaped over time. It can be queued during a partner's turn and, in the newest form, lifts the foe into a whirling spin.

rites.name: Coreornes
rites.text: A fighter's evasive crouch-and-roll technique, once given a different name later in its history. Before a later revision, pressing an unassigned input makes the fighter perform a substitute move instead.

rites.name: Lorilium
rites.text: A fighting maneuver that a skilled combatant has used in ring contests since a later tournament round. It is performed as a quick sequence of strikes.

rites.name: Renium
rites.text: A paired lifting maneuver that one fighter performs on an opponent. When two allied partners fight side by side, the same move becomes their shared combined technique.

rites.name: Niantistium
rites.text: A close-quarters technique performed by a fighter in their debut bout. It is a signature maneuver tied to one combatant's opening appearance in the arena.

rites.name: Coraullia
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a masked wrestler since his first appearance in a fighting tournament. It works against both upright and low foes, can be escaped with a quick button sequence, and chains into a follow-up slam.

rites.name: Ternollanum
rites.text: A evasive maneuver in which a fighter kicks up a cloud of grit to blind an opponent and then slips quietly out of the way. It is performed by a desert-raised duelist.

rites.name: Lauliastor
rites.text: A low sweeping strike performed by one sliding fighter, first used in a later bout of a grappling tournament. It is a technique the warrior has relied on ever since.

rites.name: Meorum
rites.text: A fighting posture that a single warrior has used since first entering the arena. It is recognized as her signature way of standing and striking in combat.

rites.name: Vonum
rites.text: A fighting technique that a single combatant has used since first appearing in a famous contest. It is a combined strike sequence built around a looping hooking blow.

rites.name: Vallia Veosaustia
rites.text: A two-step striking sequence favored by a young fighter who first mastered it years ago and later revived it in a rematch tournament. It is performed from a crouched stance and forms part of a fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Neolor Mentus
rites.text: A evasive maneuver practiced by a sharp-tempered brawler since his first appearance in a tournament of fists. It lets the fighter dodge toward safety while keeping the opponent off balance.

rites.name: Valires Nintium
rites.text: A fighting technique wielded by a single warrior since their first appearance in a rebellion-era tournament. When unleashed during a special charged state, it transforms into a more powerful variant.

rites.name: Lontanum Vones
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a certain line of automaton warriors. Holding a specific strike input at the finish of a combo builds power into the final blow, making it stronger and impossible to guard against.

rites.name: Orirum
rites.text: A ground-shaking strike drawn from a fighter's practiced stance, able to pin an opponent against barriers when blocked. In its newest form it spins the foe into a whirling gust.

rites.name: Serilum Mosium
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by a single combatant that existed in an older rendition of a duel-based contest. A second fighter from the same family can also perform it, but it no longer appears in the newest version.

rites.name: Telirnia
rites.text: A sudden grappling technique favored by a scientist-fighter who returns to the arena. It is performed to drag an opponent off their feet.

rites.name: Amiarus
rites.text: A practiced hurling motion used by a single fighter in a modern combat contest. It is a grappling throw that seizes an opponent and drives them down.

rites.name: Neseolles
rites.text: A three-part striking technique thrown in sequence, first with the rear hand, then a central blow, then the opposite hand. It is practiced by one fighter who has used it since a major tournament-style contest.

rites.name: Oraunor
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique performed by two linked warriors of one bloodline, one of whom is a darker form of the other. It serves as the fighter's empowered heat-charged strike.

rites.name: Seosanum
rites.text: A open-handed strike technique favored by one fighter of the arena circuit, used in close combat since the later rounds of the tournament. It is a palm-based attack in the hand-strike tradition.

rites.name: Coraullor
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior flings a cloud of grit into an opponent's eyes. It is used as a sudden opening move in close combat.

rites.name: Nalles
rites.text: A throwing technique that a fighter in a modern tournament uses after returning to the competition. It is a hold used by the combatant to bring an opponent to the ground.

rites.name: Coreonor
rites.text: A coiling strike used by a wielder of a mechanical fighter, first appearing in a Bloodline-era bout. In later iterations its second blow spins the opponent into a twisting spiral.

rites.name: Mosia
rites.text: A combat maneuver used by two fighters in a tournament contest. Its final strike can be held back for a moment before landing.

rites.name: Vallernor
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by one practitioner who first appeared in a recent combat tournament. It is a signature move that the fighter relies on in combat.

rites.name: Oriasus
rites.text: A whirling strike favored by a single fighter, first performed in a later arena contest. It is a spinning technique used only by one practitioner who learned it in that contest.

rites.name: Corosum Teliranum
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a single combatant since her debut in a arena tournament. It is a sudden strike that she performs in battle.

rites.name: Telestolus
rites.text: A heavy, grinding technique performed by a fighter in a single strike, once part of an older combo. It cannot be interrupted by ordinary blows.

rites.name: Teleronanum
rites.text: A swift strike technique used by a wandering duelist in a team tournament of skilled fighters. It is a follow-up attack in a combat art.

rites.name: Valirnium
rites.text: A low spinning strike that a fighter with a particular stance uses to sweep an opponent's legs from behind. It has been practiced by its user for several rounds of combat.

rites.name: Valistia
rites.text: A relentless strike that cannot be stopped or guarded against, used by a duelist in a modern fighting arena. It bypasses every defense once it lands its opening movement.

rites.name: Amonarnus
rites.text: A fighter's evasive technique where the body drops and rolls backward across the ground. It has been practiced by one combatant for many years.

rites.name: Montauria
rites.text: A swift technique for a martial artist that lets a fighter shift back into a coiling, serpentine stance by pressing a forward input after a near-final strike in a combo.

rites.name: Meornum Tornanum
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a fighter since first appearing in a combat tournament. When paired with a specific partner, it becomes a joint maneuver that combines both fighters' strikes into one move.

rites.name: Telaria
rites.text: A fighter's signature strike, first mastered by a veteran brawler in a later arena duel. In certain sequels it triggers a binding effect that holds the opponent in place.

rites.name: Rinaullium
rites.text: A fighter may trade places with a rival by a sharp push, and it comes in five forms. Only one champion still uses the common forms, and a shove into a wall lets him follow with a sure strike.

rites.name: Veonor
rites.text: A grappling technique in which one fighter hoists an opponent onto their shoulders and hurls them backward. Only a single brawler in the arena is able to perform it.

rites.name: Naliastanum
rites.text: A fighter's rapid technique is performed by a single combatant who has used it since a later installment of a sprawling battle saga. The move is known for its striking speed.

rites.name: Cantes Meontus
rites.text: A close-quarters knee technique favored by a single combatant who has used it since first entering the arena. It is a signature maneuver tied to one fighter's style.

rites.name: Telaurnium
rites.text: A charging strike delivered with the shoulder, favored by one fighter across several bouts. It is a close-range technique that opens into a swinging club-like follow-up.

rites.name: Sintes
rites.text: A disciplined striking technique wielded by a single practitioner in a renewed duel. Its variant rises into the air after a charging rush, and it can also be called upon when a fighter returns to an old form of self-defense.

rites.name: Tosor
rites.text: A fighter's technique of striking with crossed legs in a sudden scissoring motion. It is performed by a masked wrestler who uses it as a signature attack in arena combat.

rites.name: Amirnor Voria
rites.text: A brutal maneuver favored by a hulking brawler since his first appearance in the arena. It is a grinding technique that wrenches an opponent with crushing force.

rites.name: Valisum
rites.text: A fighting technique used by one warrior since her first appearance in a combat tournament. It moves from a mournful crouch into a violent, destructive stance.

rites.name: Rosernanum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that swings a heavy blow in a spinning arc. Its final strike can set off a twisting follow-up attack.

rites.name: Amellinum
rites.text: A tactical striking technique performed by a skilled fighter during team combat contests. It chains a rapid sequence of blows that drives an opponent back through a partner's support.

rites.name: Nares
rites.text: A spinning aerial technique in which a fighter flips over an opponent and drives a heel down onto them. It has been a signature maneuver of a single brawler since his first appearance in a tournament.

rites.name: Corilanum Valeonium
rites.text: A quick throwing technique that two fighters have used since first entering the tournament arena. It is passed between a pair of brawlers who learned it early in their careers.

rites.name: Ameollanum Viasteornus
rites.text: A coined strike that cannot be blocked by any guard, carried by a line of mechanical fighters. Holding the input winds it up, so it lands later and hits harder.

rites.name: Sillor
rites.text: A fighter performs a sweeping sideways kick that lashes out from a low, coiled stance. It is a technique that a particular duelist has carried through several generations of combat training.

rites.name: Amiarnor
rites.text: A stylized striking technique favored by a single fighter in a modern brawling tournament. It has been performed by that combatant in recent contests.

rites.name: Caullosia
rites.text: A rapid strike technique wielded by one fighter since she first entered a combat arena. It lets her quickly unleash a sharp, sweeping blow.

rites.name: Cerantes
rites.text: A brutal strike technique performed by a fighter in a team-based bout. It is a kick delivered with the rear limb, known for its punishing force.

rites.name: Serornus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a combatant strikes with a rightward punch, a straight thrust and a leftward hook, then slips into a quick shifting guard. It was used by one brawler for a time before a simpler variant took its place.

rites.name: Lerus Orerniasium
rites.text: A fighter's sweeping strike that lashes out with a whipping motion, drawn from a wild creature's swinging appendage. It is performed by a grappling warrior in a modern combat contest.

rites.name: Orestes
rites.text: A fighting technique used by one practitioner across several later contests before being dropped. In certain versions its opening strike forces the opponent into a helpless stagger.

rites.name: Orauseontes
rites.text: A signature maneuver used by a line of humanoid machines in combat. The fighter drops onto an opponent with a heavy seated press.

rites.name: Volauses
rites.text: A swift charging technique that a fighter unleashes while holding a particular ready posture. It has been passed down through several warriors across different contests.

rites.name: Valintes
rites.text: A fighting technique used by one warrior that replaces an older strike of the same style. It is passed down as the newer form of a earlier attack.

rites.name: Maullium
rites.text: A fighter's lunging strike used by one combatant since debut. In team bouts, its final blow can be queued early by a partner.

rites.name: Amolia Minia
rites.text: A fighter's technique that works as a low counter while a surge of power is active. It is a stronger form of an older version of the same technique.

rites.name: Orarnanum
rites.text: A grappling maneuver that a pair of fighters use to seize and hurl an opponent, which in later versions took the place of an older joint-lock hold. In team bouts it can become a combined throw when a particular ally joins the attack.

rites.name: Cesiallium
rites.text: A striking technique wielded by a fighter in a tournament of paired combatants. It is a move that channels a storm-like force through the strikes of its user.

rites.name: Teliasor
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by a brawler who strikes with forceful rushing blows. It is employed as a flourish within a larger contest of skill and endurance.

rites.name: Centia
rites.text: A swift technique a fighter uses to shift at once into a bold, lion-hearted stance. It serves as a quick opening that flows directly into a second, fiercer form.

rites.name: Telentes
rites.text: A grappling motion performed by a fighter who circles the opponent from the side. It is a throw meant to take hold of a foe during close combat.

rites.name: Sellantes
rites.text: A stylized strike that a fighter unleashes in a duel. Its second blow sets off a twisting effect on the opponent.

rites.name: Lerus Caustes
rites.text: A deliberate technique practiced by a single fighter, first displayed in a bout of the sixth grand contest. It is used as a repeated strike that the fighter has relied upon since debuting.

rites.name: Masus
rites.text: A fighter's rising kick sends a crushing blow to the foe. Struck cleanly at close quarters, it hits harder than usual, and a bear-like brawler wields a heavier version of it.

rites.name: Liasium
rites.text: A fighter's signature sequence of strikes in which the finishing blow can be held back. Its last kick can also strike an opponent who has already fallen.

rites.name: Amerneollor
rites.text: A coordinated strike sequence performed by a single fighter in a team bout, delivered with a practiced, unsettling rhythm. It is known to belong to a particular combatant and is taught through pairing drills.

rites.name: Orantor
rites.text: A fighting technique that a skilled brawler uses in a combat tournament, a twisting variant of an older spinning strike.

rites.name: Amasontus
rites.text: A spinning kick favored by three fighters across every bout they have fought. It is performed as a signature technique in their repertoire.

rites.name: Rollus
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes a rival and hurls them away. Against a barrier it can slam the target into the surface or shatter it, and it may set up a partner's follow-up strike.

rites.name: Amantium
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by one particular fighter, performed as a move in combat contests. It has been part of that warrior's repertoire since first appearing in a major tournament bout.

rites.name: Rilastum
rites.text: A swift sweeping kick practiced by a fighter of the arena. It is used as one of the strikes in a modern combat contest.

rites.name: Liarosus
rites.text: A striking technique performed by one fighter in the arena since her first appearance in a tournament. It is a signature maneuver that marks her style in combat.

rites.name: Corostium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a combatant launches a rolling cannon-fist and follows with a second blow aimed higher. Practitioners in the family line use it across several later contests.

rites.name: Coraullor Oraniantes
rites.text: A forceful technique a fighter unleashes during a bout to overturn an opponent's expected defense. It is fueled by a built-up surge of heat and serves as a decisive finishing strike.

rites.name: Oreria
rites.text: A practiced leg strike is carried by a warrior who has used it across several generations of combat contests. It is known as a signature technique passed through a single fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Ronia
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by a masked warrior in a modern arena fighting tournament. It serves as one of his special engagement techniques, letting him trap rivals in a crushing hold.

rites.name: Telisus
rites.text: A bear-like fighter's aerial strike, a rebuilt variant of an older dive technique. It can only be unleashed while a blazing surge of inner fervor burns within the combatant.

rites.name: Lirum Amaustus
rites.text: A swift, edged strike performed by a single fighter in the arena. It is a practiced technique passed through a fighting tradition across many bouts.

rites.name: Amirnum
rites.text: A signature combat maneuver that a fighter unleashes once their heat gauge is charged. It serves as a powerful finishing attack in close-quarter battles.

rites.name: Ciallostor
rites.text: A fighter's technique that chains two separate strikes together, but only when the user is infused with a dark spirit energy. Its combined sequence can be unleashed only in that empowered state.

rites.name: Telirnia Tiarnanum
rites.text: A fighter's sweeping strike that once lifted foes into the air on its own. Later revisions removed that lift, though a well-timed hit still sends the target skyward.

rites.name: Neosum
rites.text: A borrowed striking technique passed between fighters, its heavy sweep first learned from an older weapon-driven maneuver. It belongs to a brawler who wields it in contests of raw strength.

rites.name: Tauntum
rites.text: A move that cannot be blocked, used by a fighter named Oriel. Another combatant also performs it in a later contest.

rites.name: Raunostum
rites.text: A striking technique is performed by a fighter who first displayed it in a recent arena tournament. It is a signature strike that the warrior uses in combat.

rites.name: Soles
rites.text: A fighter's striking maneuver that takes the place of two earlier strikes. It is performed by a single brawler in a combat arena.

rites.name: Tinteles
rites.text: A combat maneuver that a fighter has used across several tournaments. In certain later contests, the strike forces the target into a helpless, bound state.

rites.name: Rilanum
rites.text: A short striking technique favored by one fighter, first taught to them in an earlier contest. It opens a longer chain of blows in later bouts, though it has since vanished from the most recent rulebook.

rites.name: Veles
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a brawler since their debut in a combat contest. A second strike in the sequence can leave the opponent helplessly tangled and bound.

rites.name: Corania Orarnium
rites.text: A single fluid strike performed by a fighter who has trained in it since first entering the arena. It is a repeating technique used in close combat.

rites.name: Seralornus
rites.text: A fighter's fiery low sweeping strike, used by a single warrior in a modern combat arena. It scorches the floor and knocks opponents off their feet.

rites.name: Raurus Rilia
rites.text: A fighter's thrusting technique that a skilled practitioner can flow out of into a staggering, swaying stance. Its motion is borrowed from an older, separate maneuver.

rites.name: Ameosanum Mostanum
rites.text: A fighter's low leg-strike technique, carried by one warrior since the moment that warrior first entered a sparring circle. It is a signature sweep that knocks opponents off balance.

rites.name: Menia
rites.text: A practiced strike a fighter has used for years, which can also be delayed and charged into a stronger blow when the combatant holds the proper inputs.

rites.name: Ceseostum
rites.text: A forceful punch delivered by a combat automaton, carried over across later versions of its line. A prototype unit also performs the same strike when it returns to battle.

rites.name: Sereontor
rites.text: A launching strike used by a fighter from a distant realm. It hurls a foe high into the air, and it sometimes falls short against armored opponents unless timed to hit a stagger.

rites.name: Teniallus
rites.text: A bold rushing strike that a particular fighter has relied upon in the duels of the arena since the second great tag gathering. It is performed with a sudden forward lunge.

rites.name: Vauleostium
rites.text: A practiced maneuver performed by a physician-brawler during a clash of fighters. It borrows the motion of an elder master's stealthy footwork.

rites.name: Visarnus
rites.text: A short striking technique in which a young fighter drives a heel down onto a downed rival. It is performed in a team bout, and is known to a single combatant in the circuit.

rites.name: Nialus Meostia
rites.text: A bold technique that a fighter can unleash to ignite a surge of fiery momentum. It serves as a special opener that marks the start of a heated exchange.

rites.name: Virnallanum
rites.text: A leaping strike that no guard can stop. Whoever attempts it and fails takes harm and is left sprawled on the ground for a brief moment.

rites.name: Mianum
rites.text: A quiet fighting posture adopted by one combatant since first appearing in a clash of rebellious bloodlines. It lets the practitioner move without making a sound.

rites.name: Valaunilor
rites.text: A close-range striking technique in which a fighter drives a heavy, compact blow forward in a single focused burst. Another fighter's later sharper strike borrows its basic form.

rites.name: Corisum Oriarnus
rites.text: A forceful technique wielded by a single fighter that was dropped for a time and later returned with a different input sequence.

rites.name: Coreontia
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by a skilled combatant, whose second strike can cause the opponent to spin violently. It is known by a different name in some regions.

rites.name: Sonum
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter who debuted in a modern combat arena. It is a fast strike sequence that she performs as her personal trademark.

rites.name: Raneria
rites.text: A ranged strike used by a wandering duelist that passes cleanly through other incoming hurled objects. A follow-up seizure can catch a foe who is airborne or caught from the flank or behind, but fails if the duelist is struck at the same moment the projectile lands.

rites.name: Casor
rites.text: A fighter's spinning technique that drives the shin into an opponent before a whirling hammer strike. Its final blow can cause the foe to rebound helplessly into the air.
